<?php
/**
 * HomeGlo standalone manager portal.
 *
 * Manager credentials are stored in a dedicated HomeGlo table and are NOT
 * WordPress users. The portal uses its own secure session cookie and never
 * requires wp-login.php or wp-admin for day-to-day store management.
 */
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

function homeglo_manager_table() {
	global $wpdb;
	return $wpdb->prefix . 'homeglo_manager_accounts';
}

function homeglo_manager_log_table() {
	global $wpdb;
	return $wpdb->prefix . 'homeglo_manager_activity';
}

function homeglo_manager_table_exists() {
	global $wpdb;
	$table = homeglo_manager_table();
	return $table === $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( 'SHOW TABLES LIKE %s', $table ) );
}

function homeglo_manager_ensure_table() {
	static $ensured = false;
	if ( $ensured ) { return; }
	$ensured = true;

	global $wpdb;
	$table = homeglo_manager_table();

	require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php';
	$charset = $wpdb->get_charset_collate();
	$sql = "CREATE TABLE {$table} (
		id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
		username varchar(60) NOT NULL,
		email varchar(190) NOT NULL,
		display_name varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		role varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manager',
		permissions longtext NULL,
		password_hash varchar(255) NOT NULL,
		active tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
		session_hash char(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		session_expires datetime NULL,
		last_login datetime NULL,
		created_at datetime NOT NULL,
		updated_at datetime NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY  (id),
		UNIQUE KEY username (username),
		UNIQUE KEY email (email),
		KEY session_hash (session_hash)
	) {$charset};";
	dbDelta( $sql );

	$log_table = homeglo_manager_log_table();
	$log_sql = "CREATE TABLE {$log_table} (
		id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
		actor_id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		actor_name varchar(190) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		actor_role varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		action varchar(80) NOT NULL,
		object_type varchar(40) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		object_id bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		details text NULL,
		ip_address varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
		created_at datetime NOT NULL,
		PRIMARY KEY  (id),
		KEY actor_id (actor_id),
		KEY action (action),
		KEY created_at (created_at)
	) {$charset};";
	dbDelta( $log_sql );
}

function homeglo_manager_request_path() {
	$uri = isset( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] ) : '/';
	$path = (string) wp_parse_url( $uri, PHP_URL_PATH );
	return '/' . ltrim( $path, '/' );
}

function homeglo_manager_is_portal_request() {
	if ( ! empty( $_GET['homeglo_manager_portal'] ) ) { return true; }
	$path = homeglo_manager_request_path();
	return 0 === strpos( $path, '/account' ) || 0 === strpos( $path, '/homeglo-manager' ) || 0 === strpos( $path, '/login' );
}

function homeglo_manager_portal_view() {
	if ( ! empty( $_GET['homeglo_manager_portal'] ) ) {
		$view = sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['homeglo_manager_portal'] ) );
		return $view ? $view : 'dashboard';
	}
	$path = trim( homeglo_manager_request_path(), '/' );
	if ( 'login' === $path ) { return 'login'; }
	if ( 'login/setup' === $path ) { return 'setup'; }
	if ( 'login/forgot-password' === $path ) { return 'forgot-password'; }
	if ( 'login/reset-password' === $path ) { return 'reset-password'; }
	$parts = array_values( array_filter( explode( '/', $path ) ) );
	if ( empty( $parts ) || ! in_array( $parts[0], array( 'account', 'homeglo-manager' ), true ) ) { return ''; }
	return isset( $parts[1] ) && $parts[1] ? sanitize_key( $parts[1] ) : 'dashboard';
}

function homeglo_manager_is_preview() {
	return ! empty( $_GET['wpvibe_preview'] );
}

function homeglo_manager_url( $view = 'dashboard', $args = array() ) {
	$view = sanitize_key( $view );
	$url = 'login' === $view ? home_url( '/login/' ) : ( 'setup' === $view ? home_url( '/login/setup/' ) : ( 'forgot-password' === $view ? home_url( '/login/forgot-password/' ) : ( 'reset-password' === $view ? home_url( '/login/reset-password/' ) : ( 'dashboard' === $view ? home_url( '/account/' ) : home_url( '/account/' . $view . '/' ) ) ) ) );
	if ( homeglo_manager_is_preview() ) {
		$args['wpvibe_preview'] = sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['wpvibe_preview'] ) );
		if ( ! empty( $_GET['homeglo_manager_demo'] ) ) { $args['homeglo_manager_demo'] = '1'; }
	}
	return $args ? add_query_arg( $args, $url ) : $url;
}

function homeglo_manager_setup_key_hash() {
	return '94cf0eaf47dfdf08fdce5cd3f06e240185d640edf7fe47993f2fd02ebaed67c5';
}

function homeglo_manager_setup_key_valid( $key ) {
	$key = is_string( $key ) ? $key : '';
	if ( ! $key ) { return false; }
	return hash_equals( homeglo_manager_setup_key_hash(), hash( 'sha256', $key ) );
}

function homeglo_manager_has_staff_accounts() {
	if ( ! homeglo_manager_table_exists() ) { return false; }
	global $wpdb;
	return (bool) $wpdb->get_var( 'SELECT id FROM ' . homeglo_manager_table() . ' LIMIT 1' );
}

function homeglo_manager_cookie_name() {
	return 'homeglo_manager_session';
}

function homeglo_manager_current() {
	static $loaded = false;
	static $manager = null;
	if ( $loaded ) { return $manager; }
	$loaded = true;

	if ( ! homeglo_manager_table_exists() ) { return null; }

	$token = isset( $_COOKIE[ homeglo_manager_cookie_name() ] ) ? (string) wp_unslash( $_COOKIE[ homeglo_manager_cookie_name() ] ) : '';
	if ( ! preg_match( '/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/', $token ) ) { return null; }

	global $wpdb;
	$table = homeglo_manager_table();
	$hash = hash( 'sha256', $token );
	$row = $wpdb->get_row(
		$wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT * FROM {$table} WHERE session_hash = %s AND active = 1 AND session_expires > %s LIMIT 1",
			$hash,
			current_time( 'mysql', true )
		)
	);
	if ( ! $row ) { return null; }
	$manager = $row;
	return $manager;
}

function homeglo_manager_logged_in() {
	return (bool) homeglo_manager_current();
}

function homeglo_manager_role() {
	$manager = homeglo_manager_current();
	if ( $manager && ! empty( $manager->role ) ) {
		$role = sanitize_key( $manager->role );
		return in_array( $role, array( 'owner', 'manager' ), true ) ? $role : 'manager';
	}
	if ( homeglo_manager_is_preview() && ! empty( $_GET['homeglo_role'] ) ) {
		$role = sanitize_key( wp_unslash( $_GET['homeglo_role'] ) );
		return in_array( $role, array( 'owner', 'manager' ), true ) ? $role : 'manager';
	}
	return 'manager';
}

function homeglo_manager_is_owner() {
	return 'owner' === homeglo_manager_role();
}

function homeglo_manager_permission_definitions() {
	return array(
		'orders'      => 'Orders & fulfilment',
		'products'    => 'View products',
		'add_product' => 'Add products',
		'customers'   => 'View customers',
		'suppliers'   => 'View suppliers',
	);
}

function homeglo_manager_default_permissions() {
	return array_keys( homeglo_manager_permission_definitions() );
}

function homeglo_manager_permissions_for( $manager = null ) {
	if ( ! $manager ) {
		$manager = homeglo_manager_current();
	}

	$role = $manager && ! empty( $manager->role ) ? sanitize_key( $manager->role ) : homeglo_manager_role();
	if ( 'owner' === $role ) {
		return array_merge( homeglo_manager_default_permissions(), array( 'admin', 'logs' ) );
	}

	if ( $manager && isset( $manager->permissions ) && '' !== (string) $manager->permissions && null !== $manager->permissions ) {
		$decoded = json_decode( (string) $manager->permissions, true );
		if ( is_array( $decoded ) ) {
			$allowed = array_keys( homeglo_manager_permission_definitions() );
			return array_values( array_intersect( array_map( 'sanitize_key', $decoded ), $allowed ) );
		}
	}

	return homeglo_manager_default_permissions();
}
